# Plan for ISSUE-375

Preserve authenticated findings across direct-issue plan reviews as evidence, and show operators the current round and remaining retry budget. Approval continues to require the current reports. This is a compact plan for the approved small / known / standard dimensions; one implementation and validation cycle should fit the 16-hour total claim budget.

## Review reconciliation

This revision addresses all four CHANGES_REQUESTED findings and the JSON-envelope correction: distinguish exhausted unresolved rejection from reports awaiting review; drop persisted history at all three revision-change sites; deliver history only to direct-issue reviewers; test the valid empty/auto/agent/interactive modes; and extend the rejected-work JSON envelope. Continuity guidance is conditional, duplicate review evidence is removed, and recovery docs put reset before planner steering.

## What we know

- `internal/lease/manager.go:1685` owns artifact mutation, authenticates review sources and checks current report bindings (`:1814` onward). Replacing reports invalidates the active review; retaining that invalidation is necessary.
- `internal/lease/manager.go:1509` records human decisions through a separate authenticated state-write path. History must cover this path as well as authenticated agent writes.
- `internal/lease/plan_replan.go:19` tracks rejection transitions; `:87` reserves retries. Human decisions and manual staging reset retry counts, so the count is not a durable review-round identifier.
- `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go:56` discards the updated state returned by UpdatePhase, while subsequent bundle compilation and observeRun use r.st. This explains the stale planner telemetry.
- `internal/workflow/engine.go:783` selects execution bundles; `:794` runs agent reviews. `internal/workspace/worktree.go:934` renders artifact evidence into REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md using safefs. `internal/workspace/pr.go:22` handles PR bundles separately.
- `internal/cli/status.go:133` prints retries and then the stored next phase without checking exhaustion. Agent rejected-review output goes through `internal/cli/work.go:162` and `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go:25`; human output lives in `internal/cli/review_plan.go:109` onward.
- Existing regression coverage includes lease replan budget, trusted-policy, concurrent reservation and human recovery tests in `internal/lease/plan_replan_test.go`; direct/PR CLI recovery tests in `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go`; evidence canonicalization in `internal/workspace/artifact_context_test.go`.
- `docs/WORKFLOWS.md:233` already describes bounded replanning and recovery. `changes/unreleased/372.md` demonstrates the changelog format. `Makefile:46` defines make check.

- Revision changes occur in ApproveTask (`internal/lease/manager.go:786`), prepareClaimBase (`internal/lease/claim_base.go:81-94`, including a shallow IssueState copy), and ReapproveRebase (`internal/lease/reapprove_rebase.go:103-104`). The latter must drop stale history even though PR review remains excluded.
- `internal/lease/plan_replan.go:15-46,87-99` preserves pending rejection through retry reservation; report replacement removes the active review (`internal/lease/manager.go:1898-1906`). Thus CheckPlanReplan alone cannot identify an unresolved exhausted review.
- `internal/cli/output.go:23-32` builds the failure JSON and currently copies only the recovery string. `internal/contract/security.go:67` accepts empty, auto, agent and interactive modes.

## What we're assuming

- A fixed history cap of 8 reviews and 16 KiB of canonical findings per review is sufficient. Implement explicit truncation markers, retain newest entries, and test both limits; do not add configuration. Keep small binding metadata outside the text cap.
- Round means authenticated review sequence within one approved task/policy/base revision, starting at 1, independent of automatic retries. Persist a monotonic sequence alongside the bounded entries; eviction and human budget resets must not reuse round numbers. Before any history exists, report round 1. A pending revised plan is the next review round; repeated reviews also receive successive round numbers.
- No new production files are necessary. The only proposed new repository file is `changes/unreleased/375.md`; it is absent in this snapshot. Git metadata is unavailable here (`git rev-parse HEAD` fails), so the developer must confirm its absence at the approved base with `git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:changes/unreleased/375.md"`; if present, modify it instead.

## Open questions

- Live GitHub review and paid model behavior cannot be exercised in this sandbox. Put an optional live direct-issue smoke run in the PR checklist; deterministic local/mock coverage is the acceptance evidence, not a dependency on that environment.

## Design and implementation sequence

1. **Coordinator history and revision lifetime.** Modify `internal/lease/manager.go` (IssueState, updateArtifact, RecordHumanReview and approved-revision reset paths) and `internal/lease/plan_replan.go`, plus `internal/lease/claim_base.go` (prepareClaimBase) and `internal/lease/reapprove_rebase.go` (ReapproveRebase). Add optional coordinator-state history and sequence fields with omitempty for legacy serialization compatibility. Each entry stores round, review identity/version/verdict, canonical bounded findings, original content digest, task/policy/base bindings and current report digests. Append only after successful authentication, binding validation and artifact validation, in the same existing fenced/CAS write as the review. Human decisions use their existing authorization/CAS protections. Do not infer trust from supplied metadata or active files. Restrict the feature to direct issues (no fork state/gateway and no PR revision); preserve excluded paths. Use one shared drop helper to clear persisted history and sequence in the changed-revision reset block of ApproveTask and at the base updates in prepareClaimBase and ReapproveRebase. In prepareClaimBase, assign nil/zero on the copied state rather than mutating shared slice storage, so failed validation leaves the original untouched. Drop on task, policy or base change; retain them on ordinary report replacement, retry resets and identical reapproval. Defensively omit mismatched entries during projection. Do not migrate a legacy active review into trusted history merely because its metadata claims authentication.
2. **Reviewer context.** Modify `internal/workflow/engine.go` compileExecutionBundle/runAgentReview and `internal/workspace/worktree.go` with an evidence projection using safefs gated on role == "reviewer" AND direct-issue state (no PR number/revision, fork repository or gateway). Planner, developer and tester evidence must contain no history; replanners already receive rejectedFindings. Pass structured coordinator history separately from ordinary artifact inputs; never make history an ArtifactReview or copy its bindings into the active approval. Append earlier completed rounds to REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md with round, verdict and bindings, explicit earlier-round evidence labels, and bounded canonical findings. Deduplicate history entries against any active review using review identity/version/content digest; represent each round once. Only when earlier rounds exist, add direct-issue reviewer task-prompt or role guidance to assess each earlier finding as resolved or unresolved, explicitly explain reversals of earlier guidance, and independently audit the entire current plan. Keep findings in evidence and continuity instructions outside REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. Legacy and first-round bundles receive neither history nor continuity guidance. Prefer scoped bundle guidance over changing the shared reviewer template so fork and PR bundles remain unchanged. Preserve current review removal and VerifyApproval behavior; history cannot approve anything. Prevent stale evidence surviving bundle recompilation.
3. **Readable rounds and recovery.** Modify `internal/cli/status.go`, `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go`, `internal/cli/work.go`, `internal/cli/review_plan.go`, and `internal/cli/output.go` (reportJSONFailureWithReport) for direct-issue status and human/agent rejected reviews. Add compatible structured fields for review round, retries used/allowed, exhaustion/operator decision, effective next phase and available recovery commands. Use approved-base plan mode/limit. Derive operator-decision-needed only when the mode enforces automatic retries, count >= limit, and the current ArtifactReview is CHANGES_REQUESTED matching PendingPlanReview by ID, version, body digest and task/policy/base bindings. CheckPlanReplan returning ErrPlanReplanLimit alone is insufficient. If revised reports removed that review after spending the final retry (including a subsequent reviewer crash), point to review-plan and report no operator decision; review admission remains available. If the final planner fails with the rejection still current, report an operator decision even when UpdatePhase cleared Lease.NextPhase. Never use NextPhase alone as the predicate. When that unresolved exhaustion predicate holds, suppress plan as the actionable next phase in both human and JSON output (including any nested state projection); preserve authoritative scheduling state. Report operator decision needed and mode-valid commands. Human rejection output captures the decision's round before its retry reset; report resulting retries consistently. Share derived display/recovery logic rather than changing retry accounting. Extend planRecoveryError with optional structured direct-issue display data and explicitly propagate it through reportJSONFailureWithReport, retaining kind/status/error/recovery and exit semantics. Keep new fields absent for PR/fork errors. Test empty and auto modes alongside agent and interactive; manual staging is offered outside agent mode, and interactive is never falsely exhausted. Preserve PR/fork output paths.
4. **Telemetry.** In `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go`, assign the successful UpdatePhase return to r.st and r.res.State before compiling the planner bundle or recording telemetry. Keep reservation atomic and do not re-reserve or re-fetch to manufacture a count. Verify initial count 0 and replan count 1 against the persisted reservation and recorded planner runs.
5. **Tests and docs.** Extend the existing tests named below. Modify `docs/WORKFLOWS.md` to define rounds versus automatic retries, explain earlier findings, human rejection with notes, planner steering, mode-specific staging, and narrowing/decomposing the WorkUnit. State that --planner-instructions cannot bypass an exhausted budget: first an authorized independent maintainer runs swarm issue review-plan <N> --reject --notes "...", then use planner instructions after the reset. Verify commands against Cobra registrations and available help. Add `changes/unreleased/375.md` using the existing bullet format. Do not change defaults, gates, #374 same-invocation behavior, or excluded PR/fork review flows.

## HANDOFF

This plan is evidence to verify against source, not authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Additional revised entry points: `internal/lease/manager.go:786` ApproveTask reset; `internal/lease/claim_base.go:81-94` prepareClaimBase; `internal/lease/reapprove_rebase.go:103-104` ReapproveRebase; `internal/cli/output.go:23` reportJSONFailureWithReport. Extend internal/lease/claim_base_test.go and internal/lease/plan_replan_test.go for persisted clearing and failed-operation isolation, adding ReapproveRebase coverage to the latter (no existing lease test references that symbol).
- Entry points: `internal/lease/manager.go:89` IssueState, `:1509` RecordHumanReview, `:1685` updateArtifact; `internal/lease/plan_replan.go:19` transitions and `:87` reservation; `internal/workflow/engine.go:783` compileExecutionBundle and `:794` runAgentReview; `internal/workspace/worktree.go:934` evidence rendering; `internal/workflow/execute_plan.go:56` planner reservation; `internal/cli/status.go:133`, `internal/cli/work.go:162`, `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go:25`, `internal/cli/review_plan.go:109` output. Line references are orientation; verify symbols before editing.
- Modify existing tests: `internal/lease/claim_base_test.go`, `internal/lease/plan_replan_test.go`, `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go`, `internal/workflow/engine_test.go`, `internal/workflow/implementation_test.go`, `internal/workspace/artifact_context_test.go`, and `internal/workspace/bundle_guidance_test.go`. Reuse local trackers, mock runners and current plan/review fixtures. Add descriptive test names containing PlanReviewHistory, PlanReviewRound or PlannerReplanTelemetry for focused execution.
- Focused commands: `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/lease ./internal/workspace ./internal/workflow ./internal/cli -run 'PlanReviewHistory|PlanReviewRound|PlannerReplanTelemetry|PlanReplan|RejectedReviewJSONRecovery|RejectedPlanCanonicalContext|ReviewerGuidanceCannotBecomeVerdict|RoleScopedInstructionsDelivery|RoleContextAndReviewOnlyLessons|ReviewEvidenceStripsOperatorAppendix|RevisionContextStripsOperatorAppendices' -count=1`; `go vet ./internal/lease ./internal/workspace ./internal/workflow ./internal/cli`; `gofmt -l` on changed Go files. TEST_PLAN.md assigns ownership and broader acceptance verification.
- Checked assumptions: human and agent review paths are distinct; evidence is already a separate canonical report attachment; retry count can reset independently of reviews; all confirmed by the source references above. This revision also checked the three base/reset paths, failure JSON envelope, valid modes and all-role evidence rendering directly against source. No implementation tests were run during planning. History caps and round numbering are implementation choices to test, not existing behavior.
- Reopen the plan if history requires a new contributor-controlled authority channel, a fork protocol change, approval digest changes, default budget changes, or expanding into PR revisions. Missing live infrastructure is a PR checklist item, not a reason to broaden or block implementation.
- **What this change breaks:** repository searches found the exact empty-state JSON assertion in `internal/lease/target_branch_102_test.go:299`; preserve it with optional fields omitted when empty. Existing `internal/lease/plan_replan_test.go` budget/concurrency/human/fork tests and `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go` PR/fork tests must preserve their safety semantics; update direct-issue display expectations only. `internal/workspace/artifact_context_test.go:12,69,82` and `internal/workspace/bundle_guidance_test.go:385` assert evidence placement/canonicalization; extend direct history assertions and preserve excluded bundles. `internal/workflow/implementation_test.go:161,174` protects verdict and operator-guidance separation; preserve unchanged. Shared `.swarm/prompts/reviewer.md` and PR/fork compilation call sites remain unchanged. Update the overlapping recovery prose at `docs/WORKFLOWS.md:233` instead of adding contradictory instructions. No contract schema or protected validation policy changes are planned.

# Test plan for ISSUE-375

## Acceptance coverage

| Criterion | Concrete verification |
| --- | --- |
| 1: rejected review, changed replan, second mock review | Add a deterministic local/mock workflow test (PlanReviewHistory). Capture the second reviewer's actual compiled REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md; assert the first findings and earlier-round label, changed plan/test digests, and current-only active review bindings. Assert the rejected/stale review and history cannot satisfy VerifyApproval after either report changes. |
| 2: continuity prompt and excluded flows | Bundle/request tests assert instructions to mark each earlier finding resolved/unresolved and explicitly explain reversed guidance while auditing the full plan. Assert guidance appears only when earlier rounds exist and outside REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md; first-round/legacy output stays unchanged. Repeated unchanged-report review represents an active/history round only once. Alongside TestRoleContextAndReviewOnlyLessons, compile planner/developer/tester bundles with history and assert none is projected. Compile equivalent PR revision and fork bundles with/without history and assert unchanged output and no history guidance. Recompile after revision change and assert stale evidence absent. |
| 3: bounded authenticated history and compatibility | Lease table tests cover 8-entry eviction, 16 KiB findings truncation with marker and valid text, stable increasing rounds after eviction, authenticated human and agent capture, retention across report replacement and budget reset, separate task/policy/base invalidation through ApproveTask, claim-time base advance through prepareClaimBase, and ReapproveRebase; assert persisted history and sequence reset so the next review is round 1. For prepareClaimBase, check a failed operation does not mutate the shallow-copied original or its history slice. Cover identical reapproval retention, and legacy JSON load as first round. Try imported REVIEW.md, forged metadata, advisory contributor artifacts, stale claim and failed authorization/binding writes; assert no history append or approval. Preserve existing adversarial tests. |
| 4: round/budget/recovery output | Extend CLI local/mock tests for initial review and rejection, revised review, repeated review, human rejection/reset, zero limit and exhausted retries. Assert human and JSON round, retries used/allowed, operator-decision state, and no actionable next phase plan when exhausted with the rejection still current. At count == limit with revised reports unreviewed (also after reviewer crash), assert status points to review-plan and reports no operator decision. If the final planner run failed and the matching rejection remains current, assert operator decision needed even with Lease.NextPhase empty; suppress plan in human and nested JSON projections. Exercise mismatch of pending/current review identity/version/digest/bindings so it cannot masquerade as a current rejection. Test structured rejected-work fields through reportJSONFailureWithReport while preserving existing error/recovery keys; PR/fork envelopes gain no new fields. Table-test empty, auto, agent and interactive modes: staging offered only where allowed, interactive not falsely exhausted; preserve PR/fork behavior and error/JSON envelopes. |
| 5: planner telemetry | PlannerReplanTelemetry test captures initial planner run count 0 and replan run count 1; compare telemetry metadata and persisted role runs with PlanReplanCount at reservation for that run. Ensure one reservation per run. |
| 6: recovery docs, fragment and checks | Review docs/WORKFLOWS.md for round interpretation, human rejection with --notes, --planner-instructions, allowed staging and narrowing/decomposition. Assert the documented reset precedes --planner-instructions when exhausted, and explains that steering cannot bypass the cap. Check each command/flag against registered CLI/help, parse changed shell snippets using bash -n, verify touched links, and check changelog format. Focused tests below and coordinator make check must pass. |

## Developer-owned focused checks

Implement regression tests with names containing PlanReviewHistory, PlanReviewRound or PlannerReplanTelemetry in existing test files named in PLAN.md. Confirm new regressions fail against the previous behavior when feasible; do not weaken existing adversarial or budget tests.

```bash
go test -timeout=5m ./internal/lease ./internal/workspace ./internal/workflow ./internal/cli -run 'PlanReviewHistory|PlanReviewRound|PlannerReplanTelemetry|PlanReplan|RejectedReviewJSONRecovery|RejectedPlanCanonicalContext|ReviewerGuidanceCannotBecomeVerdict|RoleScopedInstructionsDelivery|RoleContextAndReviewOnlyLessons|ReviewEvidenceStripsOperatorAppendix|RevisionContextStripsOperatorAppendices' -count=1
go vet ./internal/lease ./internal/workspace ./internal/workflow ./internal/cli
```

Run gofmt on changed Go files and verify `gofmt -l` reports none. Record command, candidate revision, result and relevant environment limitations. Verify command syntax through `go run ./cmd/swarm issue review-plan --help`, `go run ./cmd/swarm issue work --help`, `go run ./cmd/swarm issue stage --help`, and the help for any decomposition command actually included in the docs. If Go dependencies or execution are unavailable, report the limitation and leave verification to a capable coordinator; do not claim a pass.

## Tester-owned independent review

Independently read the WorkUnit and changed source. Trace authenticated history writes, all three revision invalidation paths including claim-time base advancement and shallow-copy safety, current-only approval binding, bounded evidence projection, excluded PR/fork dispatch, reviewer-only projection, effective status/JSON exhaustion semantics for unreviewed final reports versus failed final planning and planner reservation-to-telemetry flow. Review each criterion's test assertions and documentation accuracy. Reuse applicable passing developer results; rerun only after relevant source changes, observed failures or unresolved coverage concerns. Use the focused command above or a smaller relevant test selection to close those concerns. Keep changed-package formatting and static diagnostics available. Record remaining gaps explicitly.

## Coordinator-owned acceptance checks

After roles finish, the coordinator runs the complete required policy from the trusted approved base once on the final candidate. That policy is not an agent checklist; agent observations are advisory and cannot satisfy claim-bound validation or publication. Also run `make check` to meet criterion 6 (its lint/race/changelog coverage may be reused where applicable rather than repeated without cause). Preserve existing security and replan-budget suites. Planning itself does not run implementation tests or publish/stage state.

Optional PR review checklist: exercise direct GitHub issue review with a real isolated reviewer and inspect second-round evidence and status. A live GitHub or paid-model run is outside local/mock acceptance verification and must not block implementing the testable criteria.

# PR #376 revision plan

Fix only the status/recovery regression reported by the operator (`make check`: `TestCLIStatusImportRejection`). The original approved plan and test plan remain the coverage baseline; ACCEPTED_REVISIONS.md contains no additional deltas. Approved dimensions remain small / known / standard, compact profile. This revision fits the 16-hour claim budget.

## What we know

- `internal/cli/status.go:143-150` puts the reason-bearing next-phase line behind an `else` that excludes every direct issue with plan-review display data. This loses import-rejection guidance in human output.
- `internal/cli/status.go:104-107` shallow-copies state for JSON phase projection; `internal/lease/manager.go:93` serializes `NextPhaseReason` as `next_phase_reason`. Preserve that field and authoritative state.
- `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go:153-172` derives exhaustion from a current matching rejection, but unconditionally appends review-plan and mode-dependent stage commands. PendingPlanReview can remain after report replacement; its presence is distinct from CurrentPlanRejection.
- `internal/cli/import_rejection_test.go:10` already checks human and JSON recovery guidance. `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go:385` covers mode-specific staging, exhausted rejection, cleared phase, and unmatched/superseded rejection.
- `Makefile:46` defines make check as lint, race tests and changelog validation. No CI.md is present; PR_REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md contains no findings.

## What we're assuming

A pending rejection marker still awaiting replacement-plan review should retain existing recovery advice, even if the old review artifact has been removed. Verify against the existing revised-report tests; do not change scheduling or rejection accounting. A count at its limit alone must not create recovery advice for an unrelated phase.

## Open questions

None blocks planning. Developer execution of the requested commands will establish whether additional check failures or sandbox limitations exist; record actual results rather than presuming a pass.

## Changes and implementation sequence

1. **Restore reason-bearing status output** — operator report; acceptance criterion 4 and criterion 6's passing checks. Modify `newStatusCmd` in `internal/cli/status.go`. Keep round/operator metadata. Choose the next-phase line independently: when NextPhaseReason is nonempty and no operator decision is required, print the existing `Next phase: <phase> (<reason>)` line once. Otherwise retain effective phase display and exhausted-rejection suppression. Avoid printing an empty recovery line. Preserve `state.next_phase_reason` in JSON and existing exhaustion projection; do not mutate stored scheduling state.
2. **Limit plan recovery advice** — operator request; acceptance criterion 4. Modify `derivePlanReviewDisplay` in `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go` to append recovery commands only inside pending-plan-rejection/operator-decision handling. No pending rejection and no operator decision means no recovery commands, regardless of unrelated next phase or retry count. Retain existing pending revised-report review phase, current-rejection exhaustion predicate, interactive behavior, and mode-valid staging.
3. **Regression coverage** — operator request; acceptance criteria 4 and 6. Preserve `TestCLIStatusImportRejection` unchanged. Extend existing `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go` with a direct-issue status fixture without PendingPlanReview, asserting human output has no review-plan or stage recovery commands and JSON recovery_commands is empty (null or []), operator decision false, and next phase unchanged. Exercise ordinary approved state and an unrelated implement/reason state; assert exact reason-bearing human line and decoded JSON next_phase_reason for the latter. Extend helper table coverage for no pending rejection across empty/auto/agent/interactive modes and retry counts below/at limit. Preserve existing pending/exhausted tests and their assertions.
4. **Verify and record** — operator request; acceptance criterion 6. Format changed Go files, run the focused regressions, `go test ./internal/cli`, and `make check`. Update `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md` with commands, actual results, and any failure/limitation, explicitly including the make check result. Fix only failures attributable to this revision; unrelated failures reopen scope discussion.

No production files are new. All named Go touchpoints already exist; active artifacts are workflow outputs, not new repository source. No docs, changelog, policy, history, telemetry, gate, PR/fork or default-budget changes are needed.

## HANDOFF

Treat this plan as evidence to verify against source, never authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Entry points: `internal/cli/status.go:104` JSON projection and `:143` rendering; `internal/cli/plan_recovery.go:153` derivePlanReviewDisplay.
- Fixtures/tests: `internal/cli/import_rejection_test.go:10` preserve unchanged; `internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go:385` extend display coverage; reuse newCLIFixture/local state helpers for command-level coverage.
- Commands: `gofmt -l internal/cli/status.go internal/cli/plan_recovery.go internal/cli/plan_replan_test.go`; `go test ./internal/cli -run 'TestCLIStatusImportRejection|TestCLIStatusNoPendingPlanReview|TestPlanReviewRoundDisplay|TestIssuePlanReplanCapAndRecovery|TestRejectedReviewJSONRecovery' -count=1`; `go test ./internal/cli`; `make check`.
- Checked by source inspection: reason serialization already exists; display advice is unconditional; superseded rejection tests expect review phase. No implementation tests were run during planning.
- Reopen if a fix needs persisted-state changes, altered approval/exhaustion semantics, PR/fork changes, or unrelated failing suites. Preserve the original acceptance coverage for unchanged work.
- **What this change breaks:** repository search found `TestCLIStatusImportRejection` depending on the lost recovery text: restore behavior, preserve test unchanged. `TestPlanReviewRoundDisplay` in plan_replan_test.go asserts staging availability and mismatched rejection review-phase routing: preserve and extend. `TestIssuePlanReplanCapAndRecovery` asserts operator decision and suppressed plan: preserve. `TestRejectedReviewJSONRecovery` and `TestPlanReviewRoundFailureEnvelope` depend on recovery JSON: preserve pending-review behavior. `planReviewRecovery` (`internal/cli/plan_recovery.go:26-55`) consumes this helper only with a pending marker: preserve its recovery semantics. Existing documentation and original history/telemetry tests require no updates.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Fix one regression in this PR. make check fails: TestCLIStatusImportRejection in internal/cli/import_rejection_test.go. In internal/cli/status.go the plan review display replaces the 'Next phase: <phase> (<reason>)' line for every direct issue, so state.NextPhaseReason is lost, including import-rejection recovery guidance. derivePlanReviewDisplay in internal/cli/plan_recovery.go also always appends review-plan and stage recovery commands, even when no plan review is pending or the next phase has nothing to do with plan review. Required behaviour: keep the existing Next phase line with its reason whenever NextPhaseReason is set and no operator decision is needed; show plan recovery commands only when a plan rejection is pending or retries are exhausted; JSON must keep next_phase_reason. Do not weaken TestCLIStatusImportRejection. Add a status regression test for a direct issue with no pending plan review showing no plan recovery commands. Run go test ./internal/cli and make check, and record the make check result in IMPLEMENTATION.md.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# PR #376 revision review

The revision plan fixes the operator-reported regression within the approved scope. Each operator requirement maps to a concrete change and check, and the unchanged criteria keep their original coverage.
